text:
alejandra: thinking aloud — proposal to add a "delegated project key" flow to the console so org admins can mint project-scoped API keys that inherit org quotas but surface project telemetry. sketch below. thoughts?

sam: brief — 👍 on scoped keys, but we need to be explicit about quota accounting and routing. If the key inherits org quota how do we show per-project usage without double-counting?

mike: we should attribute tokens to both org and project in telemetry, but only decrement quota once. i.e. a request with delegated key -> emit metrics: org_id, project_id, key_id and only apply org quota counters. dashboards can aggregate by project_id.

irene: UX q: when an admin mints a delegated key, do we force a service-account association or allow ad-hoc keys? my vote: require SA or user-id for rotation + audit.

alejandra: agreed on SA requirement. also want to support short-lived delegated tokens for CI use — exchange flow would produce short TTL. sample policy snippet i was thinking: 
```json
{
  "token_type": "delegated",
  "scopes": ["generate","embeddings"],
  "project_id": "proj-123",
  "inherits_quota_from": "org-42",
  "aud": "inference.redwood.internal",
  "exp": 1719999999
}
```

sam: that looks fine. but watch for backwards compatibility with existing API keys: existing keys are flat (org-scoped). We should implement a compatibility layer where old keys map to org-only tokens in telemetry. Also think about routing: delegated keys should prefer project-capacity pools if policy routes by project.

mike: on routing — agree. we can add routing policy that says: if token has project_id then route to project pool, else fallback to org pool. fallback should be explicit in traces so we can debug capacity misses. add a trace tag `route_hint` and `route_fallback` booleans.

irene: consoles: rollout UX — surface a toggle when creating key: "project-scoped (recommended for services)" and an expandable section for TTL/exchange. show a warning if admin gives wide scopes + long TTL. keep default conservative.

alejandra: operational notes: rotation — require SA-backed keys to rotate via token-bot, which issues a short-lived exchange token. we should record rotation events in audit log with fields: actor, sa_id, key_id, rotation_type. token-bot, please confirm behavior.

token-bot: confirmed — when rotation requested we issue an exchange token valid for 10m, revoke the previous delegated secret on successful exchange, and emit `audit.event = token.rotation` with actor metadata.

sam: question for infra — how do we enforce per-project rate limits if quota is org-level? Proposed: quota enforcement remains org-first, but provide soft-limits per-project for alerting and optional hard-limits via per-project quota override. need API to set project_overrides.

mike: implementation detail — store token metadata in AuthDB with columns: key_id, org_id, project_id (nullable), sa_id, scopes, ttl, inherits_quota_from. Queries for enforcement use org_id lookup. Telemetry pipeline will join project_id for per-project metrics. keep the DB index on org_id first.

alejandra: ok I'll draft design doc with these pieces: console UX mockups, token schema, routing policy, metrics tags, rotation flow and audit events. will share PR for review in #eng-docs tomorrow. thanks all. :heart:
